Here’s your classic 4chan-style copypasta, complete with the signature chaotic energy, forced memes, and exaggerated despair:

---

**>be me**
**>17, femboy, closeted as fuck**
**>just wanna hold some dude’s hand in the hallway like a normal person**
**>mfw the second I even *think* about it, the entire school transforms into a fucking lynch mob**
**>mfw some chad in a letterman jacket calls me a "f*ggot" for existing**
**>mfw he doesn’t even know I *literally* jerk off to his Instagram stories**
**>mfw society has advanced enough to put a man on the moon but not enough to let me wear a skirt without getting my teeth knocked out**
**>mfw I just wanna be a cute girly boy and vibe, is that so hard?**
**>mfw the second I come out, my social life gets yeeted into the sun**
**>mfw my own parents would rather I was a meth addict than a "disgusting tr*nny" (I’m not even trans, I just like nail polish)**
**>mfw love is a crime now apparently**
**>mfw straight people hold hands in public like it’s *nothing* but the second two guys even *look* at each other, suddenly it’s "groomer hour" at the local Chuck E. Cheese**
**>mfw I’m so touch-starved I’d let a fucking *goblin* hold my hand at this point**
**>mfw I just wanna wear a cute sweater and sip a Starbucks while my boyfriend calls me pretty**
**>mfw instead I get to rot in my room listening to Cavetown and crying into my body pillow**
**>mfw the only "acceptance" I get is from anime girls who don’t exist**
**>mfw I’m one "hehe, based" away from becoming a school shooter (this is a joke pls don’t FBI me)**
**>mfw I just wanna be happy but the world has decided that’s illegal**
**>mfw I unironically relate to the "I just want to be loved" frog**
**>tfw no gf *or* bf, just a crippling sense of isolation and the knowledge that I’ll die alone surrounded by Funko Pops**
**>tfw I’m so far in the closet I’ve found Narnia**
**>tfw the only hand I’ll ever hold is my own (and not in the fun way)**
**>tfw I just wanna be a pretty boy but instead I’m a depressed gremlin who smells like Doritos and regret**
**>why does God hate me?**

---
**>posting this at 3 AM because I have no one else to talk to**
**>please respond I’m so lonely**
**>also if you’re a cute femboy hmu (no chasers)**

---
